title: OpenAI's plans to make ChatGPT more like Amazon aren't going so well | TechCrunch
summary: OpenAI is shifting its strategy from a standalone e-commerce feature in ChatGPT to a product information hub, focusing on consumer research rather than direct purchases.
sentiment_reason: The change represents a neutral market impact as it deprioritizes the e-commerce feature but still provides a valuable service by becoming a centralized hub for consumer information.
